original_record.subject: combinatorial geometry

inventory.image1: undecorated butterfly with four wings, black body/head/tail and two antennae
inventory.image2: six grayscale stickers: two small circles, two narrow black ovals, two larger darkgray circles
inventory.image3: five cyan/magenta/black decorated butterflies; all source colors preserved rather than silently recoloring grayscale stickers

answer_verification.method: Only A preserves the multiset of six supplied sticker sizes/shapes, with small circles under narrow black ovals and large circles above. B/E replace narrow ovals by dots; C/D require eight stickers.
answer_verification.source_color_note: Given sticker strip is grayscale while options use cyan/magenta. Shape/size correspondence determines A without assuming literal color equality; original mismatch preserved.

audit.explicit_conditions_vs_layout: Geometry and option identity preserved. Locations and panel spacing are display layout only.

representation_note: The original question/options/answer remain verbatim in original_record and original_question. A Choices block is appended only to expose the unchanged source options in the common answer schema.
branch_mapping_note: Formal branch follows the frozen scene geometry (2D/3D); source_category retains the upstream category.
